title: Watch: Concertgoers and pro-Palestinian activists arrive at Ed Sheeran concert
summary_full: Some Ed Sheeran fans say they are excited to enjoy music and are not there for politics after Macklemore was dropped from the tour for making pro-Palestinian comments.
